name: @jetcrab/pi-desk-workspace
description: Reusable isolated workspace pool for Pi sessions with a Pi Desk sidebar

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-assets.mjs && esbuild src/browser-entry.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react/jsx-dev-runtime --external:react-dom --external:react-dom/client --external:@jetcrab/pi-desk-sdk/react/base --external:@jetcrab/pi-desk-sdk/react/markdown --outdir=dist/browser --entry-names=entry --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash]
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
